dedupe_keys.name: top of the poops sewage spill analysis

description: Top of the Poops is a public codebase for gathering and analysing England's sewage outfall information. Its README describes scripts and a companion website that arrange published overflow records into comparable summaries. Users can inspect outfall activity by location and period; the project returns rankings and maps of reported sewage events. Geographic coverage is the UK areas for which Environment Agency data are included. The repository licence file states MIT terms for the code. A limitation is that reported spills and measurement coverage depend on upstream monitoring and disclosure; a ranking is not a hydraulic or ecological simulation. Analysts need source dates and locations before using it as a model input. The project can help calibrate wastewater overflow frequency or identify exposure scenarios for rivers. The related catalogue EPANET model concerns drinking-water distribution and is a separate resource. No upstream sewage records or website assets were downloaded.
name: Top of the Poops sewage-spill analysis
notes: G7 G7-1682. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
